question: Who has been appointed as the Chief Executive Officer of NITI Aayog in June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Parameswaran Iyer.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** current CEO of NITI Aayog** is an Indian government officer by the name of** Parameswaran Iyer.**
 
• The Indian government launched the **Swachh Bharat Mission**, a nationwide sanitation programme, in **2014.**
 
• He served as its **leader**.
 
• NITI Aayog:
 
• NITI Aayog is evolving into a** cutting-edge resource center** with the knowledge and abilities that will allow it to
 
 
• respond quickly,
 
• support research and innovation,
 
• offer the government a strategic policy vision, and
 
• handle unforeseen difficulties.
 
 
 
• The NITI Aayog is founded on **seven pillars:**
 
 
• pro-activity,
 
• pro-people,
 
• participation,
 
• empowerment,
 
• inclusion of all,
 
• equality, and
 
• transparency.
 
 
 
• **Formed:** 1 January 2015

 **Headquarters:** New Delhi

 **Chairperson:** Narendra Modi

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Avinash Kulkarni:**

 
 
• **Blue Planet Solutions' founder and CEO** is Avinash Kulkarni.
 
 
 
• **Krishna Srinivasan**:
 
 
• **​Director of the Asia and Pacific Department** is Krishna Srinivasan.
